editorial:
Imagine planning the perfect heist only to find out your partner is actually a cop. That is exactly what happens to Mason, a smart criminal who gets betrayed by his girlfriend and teammate, Decker. After she busts his whole crew, Mason disappears and tries to leave his old life behind. But when his younger brother Shawn gets in over his head during a messy bank robbery, Mason has to step back into the game. It is a high-stakes story about family, betrayal, and the thrill of the steal that keeps you guessing about who is actually in control.

You will love the fast action and the tension as the SWAT teams close in. The acting is solid, and the chemistry between the leads makes the emotional parts feel real. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the pacing is quick enough that you won't mind. If you enjoy heist movies with a romantic twist, you should definitely check this one out. It looks great in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Mason uses his genius planning to outsmart both the police and the bank security. He manages to save his brother Shawn and get the money. The biggest twist is that Mason and Decker still have feelings for each other, leading her to help him escape despite her job. They end up together, leaving the authorities empty-handed while they disappear with the loot and a fresh start.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist movies and betrayal stories.
